Log-beta convolution yields the exact logarithmic small-volume constants and right-endpoint power constants; separate Mellin-Perron and local simplex/beta derivations corroborate all asymptotic coefficients. The attached Python checker passed mathematical sanity checks. Fixed N >= 3, limit boundaries and excluded resonances are explicit.

value.rationale: The original oscillator has a continuum of nested or mutually inequivalent quasiperiodic orbit closures and no canonical finite count. Intrinsic Riemannian volume is a meaningful geometric statistic for their sizes under natural isotropic initial sampling; both very small and nearly maximally sized tori are rare. The extra unpaired direction in odd ambient dimension changes the log power at one endpoint and a half power at the other, with new exact constants; this comparative geometrical law is neither implied by qualitative existence of tori nor supplied by the cited two-component Dirichlet result. No paper-sized extension is assumed.
